name: codex-session-messenger
description: Exchange messages between local Codex and Claude Code sessions through MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Connect local Codex and Claude Code sessions.
interface.longDescription: Discover local Codex and running Claude Code sessions, exchange attributed peer messages, and read a persistent local inbox. Codex hooks deliver messages after tools finish; Claude Code hooks can wake idle sessions. Cloud-only sessions are not supported.
defaultPrompt: Read messages addressed to this session.
